blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — One of the House prosecutors in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte is San Juan City Lone District Rep. Ysabel Maria “Bel” Zamora. On Monday, Zamora leads the direct examination of the prosecution witness, Police Major Joericson Sangalang from the Philippine National Police – Firearms and Explosives Office. Zamora graduated from the University of the Philippines, where she studied political science and law. In 2009, she was admitted to the Philippine Bar.
